evidence.quote: Unknown keys are rejected — typos cause parse errors instead of silent drops.
deny_unknown_fields: typos in frontmatter keys cause a parse error.

notes: Persona frontmatter uses deny_unknown_fields, so a V6 `buzz:` block is a hard parse error; only flat top-level fields deserialize. RawManifest has no `buzz` field — a V6 plugin.json `buzz` block is ignored (validator emits an unknown-key warning per advisory_check_manifest_keys), so V6 manifests are not honored either. The legacy respond_to alias for triggers is accepted in both persona frontmatter and manifest defaults (manifest.rs:62), matching spec line 1104.
